label: NECESSARY_1-being node, tertia via reading: there is an actual root n that is God, the one God, and…
paraphrase: Necessary-being node, tertia via reading: there is an actual root n (concrete, existing at w, with no actual concrete ground) that is God, the one God (every God is n), and has the classical attributes, and n cannot not-be (IsNecessary of ST I q.2 a.3), with the primitive possibility read as the frame's diamond at w: no world accessible from w lacks n.
